analysis:
In her Budget 2025-26 speech on 1 February 2025, Sitharaman proposed that no income tax be payable on income up to Rs 12 lakh under the new tax regime, with the Rs 75,000 standard deduction raising the effective threshold to Rs 12.75 lakh for salaried taxpayers.

The change was incorporated into the Finance Act and the revised slabs applied from FY2025-26. The nil-tax threshold had earlier been raised to Rs 7 lakh in 2023.

This claim is recorded as true: the measure was enacted and took effect as announced. The relief applies only under the new tax regime, not the old one.
